title: Trupanion Claim Failure Rate
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trupanion:claim
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(claim_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by pet_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Trupanion claim records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each pet.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize claim_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per pet.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your Trupanion claim data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
